newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bremen coffee buyers active as prices drop.
newsitem.headline: Bremen coffee buyers active as prices drop.

text.p: Arabica coffee prices in the Bremen physical market fell $2-9 per 50 kg fob on the week in line with futures reductions, traders said on Friday.
Trading picked up as buyers used the opportunity to fill gaps in their cover.

Brazilian Oct/Nov exports increased after a bill to exempt coffee exports, among others, from ICMS tax was signed today and Colombian exports for Oct/Nov also improved as private exporters were given permission to sell their Dec quota early.
Hamburg traders added East Africans sold for Oct/Nov and Centralamericans for Oc 1996-June 1997. Robustas were quiet.
